pairs.subject: visual-style-locking
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/library/style/[id]/_atelier/Dossier.tsx:105 The atelier keeps the send count (SEND_REFS) as a named constant separate from the approved-only window. It requires a note before a rejection lands and offers lock only when the server's gate admits it. Changing a locked look goes through duplicate, and a style captured by adopt records its origin.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/library/style/[id]/_atelier/Dossier.tsx:105 Send count is a named constant distinct from PROOF_CAP. The domain's styleRefs sends approved, non-stale proofs only. Generation is disabled when sheet.full (Atelier.tsx line 69).

app/(studio)/library/style/[id]/_atelier/Atelier.tsx:120 A rejection cannot be sent without a reason. The port's remove-proof op is refused by the kernel for a rejected proof (packages/kernel/src/styles/core.ts:103), so rejections are never deleted.

app/(studio)/library/style/[id]/_atelier/Atelier.tsx:203 Lock is offered only when the server's gate admits it; otherwise 'lock held' shows the blocker. A refused op draws the ratchet's sentence verbatim. Duplicate is the only path to change a locked look. An unknown id is a 404, never a stand-in style (page.tsx:44).

app/(studio)/library/style/_port/fixtureActs.ts:96 Adopt reads the palette off a kept plate (the recognize model) and splits the recipe into slots. It leaves subject empty for a person to write, and the slots stay editable. Seeded forge plates come in UNDECIDED, so they must pass the gate. The origin is shown in the dossier (Dossier.tsx:47 view.origin.kind).

pairs.registryProposal: The repo's ratchet is candidate -> proven -> locked. 'proven' is earned by operator keeps in distinct cells, and lock adds trial-problem coverage on top of the technique's 'at least one approval, zero undecided'. The technique could note that a lock gate may add coverage requirements: that strengthens the gate and does not count as a deviation.
